On today's show, the US President says new talks with Iran are set to begin after he cancelled a planned attack. Oil tumbled and bonds gained on hopes for a deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. Iran says it's in the final stages of talks with Oman on a new route through the Strait, but the talks don't cover whether it will be open or closed.

title: Most Indians Fault Modi’s Handling of Exam Scandals, Poll Says
title_cn: 民意调查显示，大多数印度人指责莫迪对考试丑闻的处理
summary: Most Indians are unhappy with Prime Minister Narendra Modi‘s government over its handling of exam scandals that touched off student protests across the country, a national poll by one of the country’s largest pollsters found.
